g.text: Customer profile — Where It Lives and Who Uses It
One data asset in full: the system that masters it, the systems that read or write it, the processes that use it, the controls that govern it and the policies it is subject
to. The page a privacy or audit question starts from.

g.title: Screen transactions and parties against sanctions in line
Detect and action transaction fraud alert
Ingest clearing file and post transactions
Assess interest, fees, and minimum payment
Close account and settle final balance
Refund credit balance and report unclaimed property
